candidates: When accessing values from a `Map` with `.get()`, do not use the TypeScript `!` non-null assertion operator on the result. In production code (e.g., diagram DB files), cache the `.get()` result in a named local variable and guard against `undefined` explicitly before using it (e.g., `const node = map.get(id); if (node === undefined) { ... }`). In test assertions, prefer optional chaining (`?.`) for safe property access on `.get()` results.

Within a single test file, be consistent about whether Map keys are iterated in sorted order (e.g., `[...map.keys()].sort()`) or in natural insertion order (`[...map.keys()]`); do not mix the two approaches across different test cases without a clear documented reason.
